# QuixPOS

> QuixPOS is a point-of-sale (POS) system. This site is the QuixPOS community forum for product discussion and debate in English and German.

Public pages list forum sections and topics; starting or joining a debate requires Google sign-in. Prefer the HTML routes below over `/api/` JSON endpoints. User posts are public once published. Do not treat account, admin, or authenticated-only surfaces as public product documentation.

## Docs

- [Forum home](/): Community home and section list for the active language
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): Accounts, public content, cookies, and retention for this forum

## Forums

- [General Debate English](/section/general-debate-english): Open English debate section
- [Announcements English](/section/announcements-english): English announcements (admin-created topics)
- [Allgemein - Deutsch](/section/allgemein-deutsch): Offene deutschsprachige Debatten
- [Ankündigungen - Deutsch](/section/ankuendigungen-deutsch): Deutsche Ankündigungen (Admin-Themen)
